sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Ymir: Frost Giant''' dominates any combat he enters. But that's not all! You can use [[Titans]] like [[TCG:SAS-079|Derenzar: Unruly Titan]] and [[TCG:SAS-081|Ferric Warbringer: Spiked Warrior]] to fill your discard pile with Ice Creatures. Then, at the beginning of each round, Ymir will bring them to the Mission map! That makes it really easy to pay for Exhaust Actions, plus the Ice Creatures will provide some extra firepower. When they go down, they'll even stun heroes that would threaten their master! Discard [[TCG:SAS-082|Gawain: Forest Warrior]] when Ymir comes into play, and you'll get to ready a hero, too.
